What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Overseeing It Personally (V)]]: left, the image of [[Overseeing It Personally (V)]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Overseeing It Personally (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit a5142dd).
